nino34.label: Niño 3.4
nino34.aggregation: Equal mean of complete monthly values

relative.label: Relative Niño 3.4
relative.definition: Niño 3.4 minus tropical-mean SST anomaly; unscaled local relative index, not official RONI
relative.aggregation: Equal mean of complete monthly values

mei.label: MEI.v2
mei.definition: Standardized ocean–atmosphere multivariate index; DJ is assigned January as its end month
mei.aggregation: Mean of published two-month periods ending within the crop window; first period includes the preceding month; no extra smoothing
